lines.en: Why will the police have a difficult time?
lines.cn: 为什么警察会遇到困难呢？

lines.en: The Greenwood Boys are a group of pop singers.
lines.cn: The Greenwood Boys是一支流行歌手组合。

lines.en: At present, they are visiting all parts of the country.
lines.cn: 目前，他们正在访问该国的各个地区。

lines.en: They will be arriving here tomorrow.
They will be coming by train and most of the young people in the town will be meeting them at the station.
lines.cn: 他们将乘火车前来，镇上的大多数年轻人都会在火车站迎接他们。

lines.en: Tomorrow evening they will be singing at the Workers' Club.
lines.cn: 明天晚上，他们将在工人俱乐部唱歌。

lines.en: The Greenwood Boys will be staying for five days.
lines.cn: 格林伍德男孩们将会在这里停留五天。

lines.en: During this time, they will give five performances.
lines.cn: 在这段时间里，他们将进行五场演出。

lines.en: As usual, the police will have a difficult time.
lines.cn: 像往常一样，警方会遇到很大的困难。

lines.en: They will be trying to keep order.
It is always the same on these occasions.
lines.cn: 每次遇到这种情况，情况总是千篇一律的。
